Intangibles include a globally trusted brand, regulatory licenses, and an implicit 'too big to fail' status.

It also commands premium fees in wealth management and M&A advisory.
forensic_report.concentration_details: JPM is highly diversified across four main segments: Consumer & Community Banking, Corporate & Investment Bank, Commercial Banking, and Asset & Wealth Management. Capital supply is highly fragmented, and JPM structurally benefits from a 'flight to safety' dynamic, securing lower-cost deposits than peers. Thus, there is no critical upstream bottleneck extracting undue value.
